errors.error_description: Declared a variable using an escaped identifier with a reserved keyword name (logic \always_comb ;), improperly using a SystemVerilog keyword as an identifier.
Created an incomplete case statement that does not assign 'delta' in all paths and has no default, causing unintentional latch inference.
Assigned the registered state 'count_q' within an always_comb block, mixing combinational and sequential drivers for the same state variable.
